stories.headline: Anthropic ships extended-thinking mode for long-horizon enterprise reasoning tasks
stories.what_changed: The new mode lets the model allocate variable inference-time compute to a single query, trading latency for accuracy on multi-step analytical work.
stories.enterprise: Enterprises running multi-step analysis (audit, diligence, legal review) gain a lever to trade cost for accuracy on a per-query basis.
stories.bottom_line: Pilot extended-thinking mode on your highest-stakes analytical workflow before extending it to routine queries where the added latency is not justified.

stories.subcategory: CODING AGENTS / TERMINAL TOOLING / DEVELOPER PRODUCTIVITY
stories.headline: GitHub brings autonomous coding agents directly into the terminal workflow
stories.what_changed: A new CLI-native agent mode runs multi-file edits, test loops, and PR creation without leaving the terminal, reusing the same review pipeline as human PRs.
stories.enterprise: Coding-agent adoption is shifting from IDE plugins toward terminal-native, CI-integrated tooling that fits existing engineering workflows.
stories.bottom_line: Run a two-week pilot with one engineering team, gated behind the existing PR review process, before granting agents write access more broadly.

stories.subcategory: AI SILICON / INFERENCE ECONOMICS / DATA CENTER
stories.headline: NVIDIA's next inference chip cuts cost per token by a third at equal latency
stories.what_changed: The new accelerator targets inference rather than training workloads, with a memory-bandwidth profile tuned for long-context serving at scale.
stories.enterprise: Inference economics, not training FLOPs, are becoming the dominant lever in production AI budgeting as usage scales past pilot volume.
stories.bottom_line: Model your current token spend against the new hardware's published benchmarks before renewing existing inference capacity commitments.

stories.headline: Warehouse robotics vendor reports first fully autonomous overnight shift at scale
stories.what_changed: A logistics operator ran an unattended overnight shift across three facilities using vision-language-action models for pick, pack, and exception handling.
stories.enterprise: Autonomous operation outside staffed hours is becoming a realistic near-term target for warehouse and light-manufacturing operators.
stories.bottom_line: Identify one low-risk, low-value overnight process as a contained pilot before committing to unattended operation across a full shift.

stories.headline: FDA clears first AI triage tool for autonomous radiology pre-screening
stories.what_changed: The clearance covers autonomous flagging of urgent findings without mandatory concurrent physician review, a first for this diagnostic category.
stories.enterprise: Regulatory posture toward autonomous (not just assistive) clinical AI is shifting, with implications for liability and staffing models.
stories.bottom_line: Engage compliance and clinical leadership now to define escalation paths before any autonomous-triage pilot enters a live care setting.

stories.subcategory: AI SECURITY / SOC AUTOMATION / THREAT DETECTION
stories.headline: Security operations centers report first AI-led incident containment at scale
stories.what_changed: An SOC automation platform independently contained a live intrusion end-to-end, with human analysts reviewing after the fact rather than in the loop.
stories.enterprise: Autonomous containment (not just detection) is now operationally viable, raising new questions about audit trails and analyst oversight design.
stories.bottom_line: Require a full audit-log review process before extending autonomous containment beyond the lowest-severity incident classes.
